title: Trusted Implementer broker environment configuration

IMPLEMENTER_REPOSITORIES.description: JSON map of explicit owner/repository names to positive numeric repository IDs; 1-100 entries. No duplicate names (case-insensitive) or IDs.

IMPLEMENTER_PERMISSIONS.description: JSON object exactly equal to metadata=read, contents=write, pull_requests=write. No extra permissions.

IMPLEMENTER_PROTECTED_BRANCHES.description: JSON array of protected branch names including master and main. The authorized PR base must be included.

$comment: Environment values are strings; ConfigFromEnv validates the embedded JSON and all cross-field constraints without a JSON Schema dependency. Other environment variables are ignored. Placeholder .env.example is intentionally not runnable.
